description: Export a scene's MeshInstance3D children as a MeshLibrary for GridMap. The outputPath extension sets the format: .tres is text (prefer it: readable, diffable), .res is binary. Not for 2D scenes. meshItemNames picks a subset, else all. Overwrites silently. Returns: outputPath, itemCount, itemNames read from the saved library; warnings leads when a requested name was not exported. Errors if no valid meshes, or while a runtime session is live.

meshItemNames.description: Names of specific mesh items to export. Omit to export all.

outputPath.description: Output path for the MeshLibrary (relative to project). Its extension sets the format: .tres writes text, .res writes binary. Prefer .tres.

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

scenePath.description: Scene file path relative to the project

name: export_mesh_library
